title: nf-core/ezflux pipeline - params.growth_input schema
description: Schema for the samplesheet provided with params.growth_input: growth results (GrowthResults zips) of earlier runs that are merged without simulating anything.

sample.errorMessage: sample must be provided and cannot contain spaces

growth_zip.errorMessage: growth_zip must be an existing GrowthResults .zip (growth/<sample>__<medium>.zip or <name>.growth.zip of an earlier run)

build_manifest.errorMessage: build_manifest must be an existing .csv (<sample>__<medium>.build_manifest.csv or <name>.found_fraction.csv)

items.errorMessage: Each row needs sample and growth_zip (build_manifest is optional)
